notes: AMENDED 2026-08-01 for Sam's ruling R3 (co-residency). Scope is unchanged in shape but three things move. (1) THE sets-not-l1 WIDENING IS NOW MANDATORY AND BIGGER: with two real gateway files plus a barrel, the forbidden-target regex must name all three, and routes.js STAYS whitelisted on routes-is-the-gateway even though a barrel no longer imports sets/** — dropping it would be an unrelated semantic change. (2) shared/set-context.js NEEDS NO RULE. It is ordinary L2: it stores set ids and prefixes handed to it and imports nothing under sets/, so the existing L2 rules already cover it. Adding a bespoke rule would be noise and is explicitly out of scope. (3) THE CLONE RATIONALE CHANGES ENTIRELY — this is the substantive amendment. The round-1 justification was that vitest isolates files into workers and configure* are last-write-wins assignments, so a cloned file could safely re-point the SINGLE-SLOT singletons. Those singletons no longer exist: pp-056 (P-9) keyed every seam by set. The reason to keep separate files is now plain readability and independent failure attribution (FD-10 as revised), and the mechanics are simpler than before — FD-17's sole-registered-set fallback means each clone, composing exactly ONE set, resolves currentSetId() with no context plumbing at all. A clone that needs withSetContext is composing more than one set and is wrong; the ONE file that legitimately needs explicit context is co-residency.test.js (pp-006/pp-007), which is not a clone. What DOES change mechanically in every clone: each configure*/buildDispatch call takes setId as its FIRST argument. The old load-bearing warning survives intact and is still the most likely silent defect here: never compute a set-derived value at module load (contract.test.js does exactly that at line 43, and the global setupFile would make a cloned copy read the LIVE-ANIMALS manifest). Clones still do not call configureCommodityReference — under per-set keying the plant slot is deliberately empty (FD-5/P-2), which is stronger than the round-1 'inert' framing. RETAINED DECISIONS: one-load-per-request.test.js is NOT cloned — verified live, it network-mocks the L2 REAL records adapter against /fulfilments|/notifications|/proposed-notifications, live-animals-only machinery the plant path never executes; the plant analogue belongs to pp-008's adapter tests. The contract clone keeps its completeness-guard test (mechanises T-5's standing rule and is the minimal way to keep an it.each table green at zero cases). IDENTICAL_ALLOWLIST stays set-prefixed. NEW small addition to routes.plant-products.test.js: assert every plant route path is PREFIX-FREE, because under the mount prefix a hand-prefixed path silently serves at /plant-products/plant-products/… — a co-residency-specific failure mode with no pre-reversal analogue. DEP NOTE: pp-010 depends only on pp-007, which transitively guarantees pp-056/pp-057/pp-006/pp-053 and therefore both gateway files and the keyed seams. Exemplars: src/server/app/{contract,routes,indexed,store-ops,copy-convention,copy-parity}.test.js, test/setup-obligation-set.js, .dependency-cruiser.cjs (routes-is-the-gateway and sets-not-l1 rules), package.json script block.
